answerEligibilityForAcceptance: Preserve every relevant supplied day, opening period and price; explicitly say free when supplied
Acknowledge requested missing details rather than invent dates, slots, fees or availability
Correct false premises using the supplied record
Make two visits understandable when requested without inventing appointments
Use clear equivalent 12-hour time formatting for the pilot candidate without changing day or time meaning
Keep any closing question relevant to a real ambiguity

humanRatings.naturalness: Existing 1-5 instrument; judge grammatical conversational fit, not substring compliance
humanRatings.acceptance: Acceptable as written versus needs revision or rejection
humanRatings.notes: Request reasons for mostly-correct and rejected answers; preserve exact original feedback

analysis.releaseThresholdDecision: Must be agreed before any future scored generation; no threshold is retroactively imposed on baseline returns
